name: Bindle
tagline: Push a card across the table and take what comes back.
core_loop: On your turn lay a rank-adjacent card on your own stall for safe points, or hawk a card onto a rival's stall and take a blind card back from their hand while a customs die may expose it.
win_condition: Highest score when the draw pile runs out and the round is finished; chains pay their length (doubled on suit match) and each joker left in hand costs 5.
